Fig. 4: Benefit of Visuotactile Perception. The three rows compare the warped point clouds, obtained by temporally integrating per-frame tracking results: our full visuotactile approach, tracking without tactile optimization, and the RGB ground truth. Our method yields superior tracking accuracy under occlusions caused by the gripper, confirming the advantage of integrating tactile feedback into the tracking pipeline.
